articles.summary: Agreement Advances BlueLinx's Specialty Products Growth Strategy and Expands Access to an Industry Leading Outdoor Living Brand BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced a strategic distribution partnership with Trex Company (NYSE: TREX), the world's largest manufacturer of wood-alternative decking and residential railing and the leading brand in composite decking. BlueLinx will distribute Trex decking and railing products across a broad service territory supported by its distribution centers in Indianapolis, St. Louis, Cincinnati, Erwin, Nashville, Atlanta, Birmingham, Memphis, Gulfport, Little Rock and Monroe. The territory spans key markets throughout Missouri, Illinois, Ohio, Kentucky, West Virginia, Tennessee, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and Georgia. articles.summary: BlueLinx continues to execute its Outdoor Living specialty products growth strategy through expanded distribution of category leading railing products BlueLinx is expanding RDI® railing distribution to eight additional locations in key U.S. markets The expansion will increase BlueLinx’s RDI railing footprint from 13 to 21 BlueLinx distribution centers BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced that it is expanding RDI® railing distribution to eight additional locations in key U.S. markets, bringing the company’s total RDI distribution footprint to 21 locations. The expansion advances BlueLinx’s Outdoor Living specialty products growth strategy by better pairing a category-leading railing brand with the company’s national and local market customer base, supply chain expertise and value-added distribution services in more markets across the company’s country-wide distribution footprint.
